es419.note: Vosotros (you all) is Spain's form. Latin America says ustedes: ¿Desde cuándo esperan el autobús?

tandemFrageBeispiel.antwort: Sí, acabo de hablar con ella.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “¿Todavía vives en Valencia?” (Put the verb in the right form.)

B hears the question and builds the answer with a helper verb: acabar de + infinitive (a moment ago), volver a + infinitive (again), dejar de + infinitive (stop), seguir + gerund (still), llevar + time + gerund (for so long). Put the blue verb in the right form, choose a or de when the tile offers it, and turn the next verb into an infinitive or a gerund (-ando, -iendo). A tile in brackets such as (yo) says who is meant; you don't write it.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Acabo de + infinitivo. Vuelvo a + infinitivo. Dejo de + infinitivo.
